SideSpeed 0.5.2 adds an About screen and makes updates more reliable.

## What's new
- **About screen.** Press **About** on the Apps screen to see your version, check for updates right away with **Check for updates**, and find a QR code to support the project on Ko-fi. Made with love by DevJardins.
- **Launch time for more apps.** **Measure** now works on apps whose main screen is a nested class (activity names with a `$`), which it used to refuse.

## Fixes
- **Update now confirms the install.** SideSpeed now checks that the new version is actually installed before treating an update as done. If the helper goes away mid-update, SideSpeed falls back to Android's install prompt instead of stopping.
- **Faster animations restore exactly.** Restoring your original animation speed works for any value Android stores (for example 0.333), and a refused change now says so instead of asking you to update the helper.
- **Safer network and helper limits.** The update check reads at most 256 KB from GitHub, a stuck install is stopped after 3 minutes, and the Companion's live status no longer blocks while SideSpeed reads it.

**Updating from 0.5.0 or 0.5.1:** press **Update now** on the update notice. From 0.4.0 or earlier, update once with Downloader (code **3503400**) or `sidespeed.app/tv`.

Updating stops the helper, as before. On Google TV, open SideSpeed to start it again; on Fire TV, the Companion starts it.

The Companion apps have no changes in this release.

## Downloads
**On the TV:** open the Downloader app and enter code **3503400**, or go to `sidespeed.app/tv`. Both always get the latest SideSpeed APK.

**Companion:** open `sidespeed.app/phone` on your phone, or see [sidespeed.app](https://sidespeed.app) for the desktop installers.

| File | For |
|---|---|
| `SideSpeed-0.5.2.apk` (also as `SideSpeed.apk`) | The TV app (Android TV, Google TV, Fire TV with Fire OS) |
| `SideSpeed-Companion-0.5.2.apk` (also as `SideSpeed-Companion.apk`) | The companion for Android phones |
| `SideSpeed-Companion-0.5.2-macos-arm64.dmg` | The companion for macOS (Apple silicon) |
| `SideSpeed-Companion-0.5.2-windows-x64.msi` | The companion for Windows |
| `SideSpeed-Companion-0.5.2-linux-amd64.deb` / `-x86_64.rpm` | The companion for Linux |
